behavior_contracts.AE18/equivalence: Recursive and map forms agree on identical inputs: empty, singleton, 3x repeated, 4-mixed and 12-element spread-built arrays compare equal by length and full folded content; snapshot inputs preserve occurrence ids, kinds and positions.

behavior_contracts.AE18/snapshots: Opaque standard occurrences pass through map by identity; reconstruction mints exactly one new outer aggregate occurrence while inner ids, kinds, messages and causes are unchanged.
